_comment: Load-test observability dashboard for issue #239. SigNoz query-builder widgets (queryType=builder) against the OTLP metric keys as SigNoz stores them (dotted: http_server_requests_seconds.count / .bucket, jvm_gc_pause_seconds.sum; custom: translatr_apikey_*). Validated live on 2026-09-09 against a running translatr load test. NOTE: the Persistence/Agroal-pool row is omitted — quarkus.datasource.jdbc.enable-metrics is BUILD-fixed and was not baked into the Dockerfile.jvm image used for that run. Re-export from SigNoz after tuning panels in the UI.
title: Translatr — Load Test
description: Throughput, latency percentiles, error rate, JVM runtime, cache, and API-key usage for a translatr-loadgenerator run.

widgets.title: Write requests / min
widgets.description: http_server_requests_seconds.count · sum_rate * 60 · method in (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE)

widgets.title: Parallel sessions
widgets.description: http_server_active_requests · avg (in-flight HTTP requests right now)

widgets.title: Total users
widgets.description: traces · count_distinct(user.id) — distinct authenticated users seen in the selected window (span attribute stamped by ApiMetricsFilter; needs TRANSLATR_OBSERVABILITY_METRICS_ENABLED, which the SigNoz overlay sets)

widgets.title: Total requests
widgets.description: http_server_requests_seconds.count · sum over the selected time range

widgets.title: Avg GC pause duration (ms) by action
Vert.x worker pool: queue depth vs active
Worker pool rejected tasks/s
widgets.description: worker_pool_rejected_total · sum_rate — any value above 0 means the pool is saturated and dropping work

widgets.title: DB connection pool: active vs available vs max used
widgets.description: agroal_active_count, agroal_available_count, agroal_max_used_count — pool is maxed when active+available approaches DATABASE_MAX_POOL_SIZE (default 10)

widgets.title: Threads waiting for a DB connection
widgets.description: agroal_awaiting_count — any sustained value above 0 means the pool is exhausted and requests are queueing for a connection

widgets.title: DB connection acquire time (ms)
widgets.description: agroal_blocking_time_average_milliseconds, agroal_blocking_time_max_milliseconds — time a thread waits to get a connection; rising values precede acquisition-timeout errors (DATABASE_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT, default 5s)
